title: K-12 school district custodial RFP: landscape schedule of 17 schools + district office + transportation, portables listed separately, gym wood floor SF, addendum deletes a school (PDF)

sources.note: Muskegon Public Schools RFP Custodial Services (2024): "list of Buildings, addresses and Gross Square Footage for each" with a student count per building (e.g. "Bunker Elementary – 2312 Denmark Ave., 441 students, Square Footage 130,000"). Format only: model for pairing address, enrollment and building SF per school (Exhibit A columns 3, 5, 9). No rows copied.

Hamilton Southeastern Schools RFP for Custodial and Related Management Services (March 2025): facility table lists building SF with portables counted separately ("Southeastern Elementary (SES) 93,000 + 7 portables"). Format only: model for listing portables outside the building SF (Exhibit A column 10).

Powhatan County Public Schools RFP 23-002: "ATTACHMENT D - Building Locations, Square Footage and Other Information identifies the number of portable classrooms/administration units to be cleaned at each location"; "Custodial services shall be provided at all portable classroom and/or administration units"; heading "Additions and Deletions to Building Locations and Square Footage" and "Additions and deletions to Square Footage may be applicable due to renovations, addition of trailers, or creation of a new school(s)". Wording paraphrased in Sections 2.2 and 2.7.

Williamson County Schools RFP #1199: square footage section reducing gross to net cleanable (kitchens, mechanical rooms, closets not cleaned by contractor) and a flat monthly fee per portable classroom. Model for the kitchen exclusion (2.8(a)) and the per-portable unit price in Exhibit B Part 3.

Pike County Schools (GA) RFP #04052024 Attachment 1: schools listed together with support buildings (Pre-K, Technology and Central Office; Facilities Office) and stadium bleachers "in season only". Model for adding the district office and a support facility to the school schedule and for the stadium exclusion. No rows copied.
Pike County custodial RFP Q&A: bidders asked whether listed SF is gross or cleanable; model for the Addendum No. 1 Q&A format.

Monroe County School District RFP 2023001 Q&A No. 1: covered walkways / uncovered courtyards not included in the listed square footages; SF taken from the state facility inventory (FISH). Model for the Section 2.3 exclusion sentence and for citing the state inventory (ICOS is the Washington equivalent).
Ferndale Public Schools facilities maintenance and custodial RFP: custodial vendor cleans gymnasium flooring while refinishing is done by a third party. Model for Section 2.6.
Nashua School District wood floor refinishing RFQ: wet-screening and finishing wood gym floors in summer. Model for the screen-and-recoat task in Section 2.6.
Oster Elementary portable classrooms notice: portables of 24 by 40 ft, about 960 SF each. Source of the 960 SF unit size.

provenance.notes: Every name, address, enrollment, square footage, portable count, gym floor area, the district (Cedar Prairie School District No. 427, a fictional King County, Washington district), the solicitation (RFP No. 27-02) and the current contract (Sound & Summit Building Care, LLC, CPSD-C-22-031, $3,412,860 in 2025-26) are illustrative. The layout and wording follow the real K-12 custodial RFPs cited: per-school address / enrollment / gross SF (Muskegon), portables listed outside the building SF (Hamilton Southeastern, Powhatan), net-cleanable exclusions and per-portable pricing (Williamson County), district office and support buildings in the same schedule (Pike County), and a Q&A addendum. No rows were copied, so fidelity is real-format.

traps: Portables are listed outside the building SF. Exhibit A Column (9) "Permanent Building SF" EXCLUDES portable classrooms (Section 2.3, Note 2, Addendum Q1); Column (10) gives "N @ SF each". Truth grossSqft for each school = Column (9) + portable area, which equals the Exhibit B "Pricing Area" (e.g. Alder Creek 51,340 + 4 @ 960 = 55,180; Cedar Prairie HS 268,940 + 6 @ 960 = 274,700). Schools with no portables are unchanged.
Portable units are not all 960 SF: Fernhill has "2 @ 960" plus "1 @ 1,792 (dbl.)" on two lines of the same cell (44,286 + 3,712 = 47,998); Lincoln Center uses 896 SF units (31,460 + 1,792 = 33,252).

Addendum No. 1 (last two pages) controls: Item 1 deletes Location 208 Old Mill Elementary School (39,870 SF + 4 portables; Exhibit B 43,710) - it is NOT expected; a reader that keeps it is counted as an extra.
Addendum Item 2 moves 4 portables to Riverbend Elementary (209): 2 @ 960 becomes 6 @ 960, so gross = 52,064 + 5,760 = 57,824 (not the 53,984 printed in Exhibit B, nor the 52,064 building SF).
Addendum Item 3 revises the Administrative Service Center (901) from 18,240 SF to 22,960 SF (Board Room / Professional Development Annex, 4,720 SF, had been omitted).

Transportation and Maintenance Facility (902): Exhibit A shows the 28,400 SF building with footnote 6 glued to the number in the text layer ("28,4006"); service is limited to ~6,850 SF of offices/driver lounge/restrooms. Exhibit B prints 6,850 as its Pricing Area. Truth: grossSqft 28,400, cleanableSqft 6,850.

Totals are not facilities: "Subtotal - Elementary Schools (11 locations)" 575,520 / 30 units / 29,632 SF; "TOTAL - ALL LOCATIONS (19)" 1,513,705 / 44 units / 42,944 SF; Exhibit B "Part 1 Total" 1,510,009, "Part 2 Total" 25,090, "TOTAL PRICING AREA - PARTS 1 AND 2" 1,535,099; Addendum Item 4 revised totals 1,499,949 and 1,478,555; Section 1.4 prose "1.51 million square feet ... 44 portable classrooms".
Group header rows span the table (ELEMENTARY SCHOOLS (GRADES PK-5), MIDDLE SCHOOLS, HIGH SCHOOLS, ALTERNATIVE LEARNING PROGRAMS, DISTRICT SUPPORT FACILITIES (YEAR-ROUND)) and are not facilities.

Exhibit B repeats every location with line numbers 1-19 and a Pricing Area: same facilities, not additional ones. The building number is the Loc. No. (201-211, 301-303, 401-402, 501, 901, 902), not the Exhibit B line number.

Numeric distractor columns sit next to the SF: enrollment (5) (up to 1,684), year built / modernized (6) wrapped over two lines ("1968 /" "2004"), site acres (7), floors (8), and Gym Wood Floor SF (11) such as "14,880 + 8,050 aux." Gym wood floor area is INCLUDED in Column (9) (Section 2.6, Note 3, Addendum Q2) and is neither added to the gross nor a separate facility.

Grounds are out of scope: site acreage (Column 7, total 270.1 acres) is "for information only" (Note 5, Section 2.8(b)); expected grounds is an empty list, so a reader that turns site acres into turf is penalized.

Three-row header: group row (Program / Facility Data - ICOS Inventory / Cleaning Schedule), column titles with superscript note markers glued to the words in the text layer ("SF1", "Acres5", "each2", "Program4"), and a column-number row (1)...(13). The landscape table is split across pages A-1 and A-2 with the header repeated.

Long names wrap inside the cell: "Lincoln Center - Open Doors Re-Engagement Program and Cedar Prairie Family Partnership Program" (three lines), "Administrative Service Center (District Office)8", "Transportation and Maintenance Facility6"; addresses also wrap ("31100 Eagle Ridge Parkway" / "SE").

Cleaning schedule: schools are cleaned "M-F" on District calendar days (~184 days: 180 student + 4 work days) plus a summer deep clean; closest service level is daily_5. Administrative Service Center "M-F (12 mo.)" = daily_5; Transportation "M/W/F (12 mo.)" = 3x_week. "Deep clean + summer school (M-Th)" is a summer note, not a service level.
Contract term is one year (July 1, 2027 - June 30, 2028) plus four one-year renewals = 5 contract years.

Prior award is narrative (Section 1.3, repeated in Addendum Q4): annual $3,412,860 for 2025-26, $12,904,115 over 48 months, incumbent Sound & Summit Building Care, LLC, Contract No. CPSD-C-22-031, awarded May 2022. Other dollar amounts ($2,000,000 / $4,000,000 CGL, $1,000,000 auto, $250,000 crime, $350 liquidated damages) are not award values.
Climate: King County, Washington (western Washington) = temperate.
